parsed.note_claim: Caustic soda can cause severe burns and pipe damage.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Products containing lye or caustic soda can damage PVC, copper, iron, and galvanized pipes, driving up repair costs. These drain cleaners can cause burns, permanent tissue damage, and serious lung irritation from the fumes.
parsed.reason: The page explicitly states that caustic soda damages pipes and causes burns and tissue damage, directly substantiating the note's claim.
